purpose: Test the four committed project SWCs against the four recorded Point_data root coordinates under simple nm-to-um conversion, while explicitly preserving the published population-alignment boundary. This is a pre-alignment baseline and is not a provenance rejection.

empirical_similarity_fit_hypothesis.warning: This is a fitted four-point similarity transform only. No historical source, notebook, parameter, or software path found so far establishes that scale/rotation/translation was used to create Point_data. It must not be used as provenance.

published_generator_context.operation: convert Reduced_dendrites from nm to um, then tree.get_root_coordinate()
published_generator_context.upstream: PP3 creates Reduced_dendrites through subtree extraction and forest reduction

public_toolchain_semantics.import_swc_finding: import_swc reads SWC coordinates into a Tree; set_units declares spatial units without rescaling geometry.
public_toolchain_semantics.convert_units_finding: convert_units is the explicit operation that rescales morphology coordinates between units.
public_toolchain_semantics.alignment_finding: align_forest recenters pooled coordinates at the centroid and applies PCA rotation; it does not apply a scale factor.

proven: The committed SWCs do not reproduce the recorded Point_data roots by simply dividing their raw parent=-1 coordinates by 1000; this remains a valid pre-alignment baseline result.
The published subtree-selected nodes reproduced from the public algorithm also do not reproduce the recorded Point_data roots by simply dividing by 1000; this remains a pre-alignment baseline result.
The public NeuRosetta import path does not contain a hidden coordinate rescaling at SWC import; explicit unit conversion is a separate operation.

The public study defines global alignment separately for dendrite populations/hemispheres, including recentering and rotation, so raw project coordinates and Point_data coordinates are not an apples-to-apples frame comparison.
The public PP4 notebook applies those alignment operations in memory and does not persist the transformed forest in the shown notebook.
The public Zenodo metric archive does not expose the Reduced_dendrites or .nr intermediate morphology trees needed for direct recovery of the historical aligned root state.
The December 2025 Point_data commit itself contains only the Point_data artifact, so that commit does not reveal its producer implementation.
The historical December 2025 Point_data snapshot is materially distinct from the later August 2026 Zenodo point_data snapshot despite preserving the same anchor IDs.
The four historical Git anchor rows provide exact IDs that match the project's four anchor IDs; their root coordinates are different from the later Zenodo coordinates.
not_proven: This pre-alignment mismatch does not disprove historical Point_data provenance.
The fitted similarity transform is not a provenance result and must not be treated as the historical transform.
No exact December 2025 generator, exact aligned source morphology materialization, historical save point after population alignment, or exact execution environment has yet been recovered.
The later Zenodo Point_data root coordinates must not be substituted for the historical December 2025 root coordinates.
The artifact delta does not identify the missing producer or transformation that created either snapshot.
interpretation.next_target: Recover a historical or locally materialized population-aligned Reduced_dendrites state (or an exact December 2025 alignment/save notebook) and compare the four Point_data anchors in their correct population-specific frame.

alignment_boundary_evidence.method_summary: The study aligns dendrite populations separately for each population/hemisphere using mean-centering, PCA/eigendecomposition, fitted-sphere centering, and final axis/orientation rotations before spatial analysis.
alignment_boundary_evidence.persistence_observation: The public PP4 notebook has no save_forest call after the global alignment/recenter/rotation operations; it sends the transformed sub_forest to a viewer instead.
alignment_boundary_evidence.metrics1_observation: Metrics1_Point_data independently reloads Reduced_dendrites and then obtains root_x/root_y/root_z from tree.get_root_coordinate() after nm-to-um conversion.
alignment_boundary_evidence.implication: A raw V229 SWC root-versus-Point_data root mismatch cannot by itself adjudicate provenance because the published study defines a population-specific aligned coordinate frame and the exact historical persisted input state is not recovered.

snapshot_boundary.purpose: Independent binary/decoded comparison of the historical December 2025 Point_data.pkl artifact and the later August 2026 Zenodo point_data.pkl artifact.

proven: All four anchor IDs are identical between the historical and later snapshots.
The snapshots are not byte-identical: their SHA-256 digests and sizes differ.
The later Zenodo snapshot has 11838 rows versus 5828 historically.
All four anchor root coordinates differ between snapshots.
All four anchors differ in at least one morphology metric; T5c preserves leaf count but changes segment/node/branch counts and cable.
Therefore any provenance argument that treats the later Zenodo point_data.pkl as byte-identical to the December 2025 Point_data.pkl is false.
not_proven: The snapshot delta does not by itself reveal the exact producer transformation.
The delta does not prove whether the changed morphology arose from new source skeletons, manual corrections, reduction parameters, coordinate materialization, or a combination.
The exact December 2025 producer remains unrecovered.

verification.correction_scope: The earlier audit evidence selected subtype rows by nearest root coordinate to the later Zenodo root. This snapshot evidence is now hardened by exact ID selection; the four decoded anchor rows were reselected by Root ID and each matched exactly once.
